ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Event, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (ByrdSwoop.cs:19-22) == cost 0 / ATTACK / EVENT / ANY_ENEMY. No keywords.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(14m, ValueProp.Move)` (ByrdSwoop.cs:17) == `_damage = 14`, powered on both sides.

OnPlay.rationale: `DamageCmd.Attack(14).FromCard(this).Targeting(cardPlay.Target)` (ByrdSwoop.cs:27-30) == the sim's single `DamageCmd.deal(..., dealer=ctx.player, card=self)`. Presentation, folded in: WithAttackerAnim's `GetPet<Byrdpip>()` and WithHitFx (28-29) are animation/SFX routing -- the pet is the ANIMATION source, not a second dealer, so damage attribution is unchanged.

guards.rationale: AnyEnemy cards always resolve a target; `ctx.resolve_target(target_idx)` is the equivalent contract.
